rows.note: Launch plan storage, billed per GB-month with no included allowance (Launch has no free storage tier; only Free has 0.5 GB/project).
Launch plan public network transfer (egress): 500 GB per project included, then $0.10/GB.
Pro plan base subscription: 'From $25/month' for the first project (includes $10/mo compute credit covering one Micro instance).
Pro plan disk size: 8 GB included per project, then $0.125 per GB.
Pro plan egress: 250 GB included, then $0.09 per GB.
PlanetScale Postgres HA (3-node: 1 primary + 2 replicas) cluster fee for the PS-80 arm64 SKU (1 vCPU, 8 GiB memory) in AWS us-east-1, from the official pricing table.

Postgres HA network-attached storage: first 10 GB free, then billed per GB beyond that; rate derived exactly from the live pricing calculator's computed total (delta of $375 for +1000 GB, i.e. $0.375/GB, independent of cluster SKU size).
Postgres HA egress bandwidth: '100 GB of egress bandwidth is included. Additional usage: $0.06/GB.'

PlanetScale Postgres EBS single node (non-HA), the cheapest paid Postgres cluster: 'PS-5 / 1/16 vCPU / 512 MB memory / 10 GB storage / $5 / Includes 1 node' in the AWS us-east-1 calculator, matching the published SKU table ('Postgres EBS non-HA (single node)': PS-5 x86-64 and PS-5 arm64 both $5). Calculator's estimated monthly total at the default 10 GB storage and 10 GB egress is $5.

Postgres EBS network-attached storage on a single node: 'the first 10 GB is free, with per-GB pricing beyond that'. Rate derived exactly from the live calculator's estimated monthly total, holding egress at its 10 GB included level: 1010 GB storage gives $130 against a $5 base, i.e. $125 for 1000 GB beyond the included 10 GB = $0.125/GB. One third of the $0.375/GB HA rate, which provisions the volume on all three nodes.

Single-node PS-5 egress bandwidth: '10 GB of egress bandwidth is included. Additional usage: $0.06 / GB.' The included allowance is SKU-specific and lower than the HA cluster's 100 GB. Confirmed against the calculator total: 1010 GB egress gives $65 against a $5 base, i.e. $60 for 1000 GB = $0.06/GB.
Entry PostgreSQL plan at $15.15/month; the base tier includes a 10 GiB to 30 GiB storage range. attributes.storage_gib records the floor of that range, 10 GiB, not the full range.
Storage expansion beyond the plan's included 10 GiB, quoted as $0.215/GiB/mo and sold in 10 GiB increments.

Essential 2 plan at $20/month including 32 GB of storage; Essential tiers bundle storage with no separate per-GB charge.
